# Module:options

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Get the state of all module options.

```lua
local options = module:options()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

options (table)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
module.options()
```
